name: Seigi no Heroine Kari ~Gekka Senshi: Blue Moon~
original_name: 正義のヒロイン狩り 〜月華戦士 ブルームーン〜
source:
I've hated the "justice league" for years.
They're bullies, nothing more.
Justice will always prevail? It's an outmoded idea.
I'm tired of vigilante heroes making decisions about
who's allowed to be bad, and how much.
I'm a vigilante against the justice league:
I'm a "justice hunter"!

"Y, you coward......!"

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ173037.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
